# Introduction
This reproducible scientific report is formatted using the **PocketGull Math** Quarto extension, providing optotypic clinical legibility and OpenType math rendering.

# Pharmacokinetic Equations
The intravenous bolus decay curve follows:

$$C_p(t) = \left[ \frac{D \cdot k_a}{V_d \cdot (k_a - k_e)} \right] \left( e^{-k_e t} - e^{-k_a t} \right)$$

# Telemetry Confidence Intervals
Under DINOv2 feature representations, the test AUC achieved:

$$\mathrm{AUC} = 0.854 \quad (95\% \text{ CI } [0.832, 0.876], \ p < 0.001)$$
